en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like there's some kind of secret about
that funeral. I can't stop thinking about it.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it's hard to deduce anything
from such a short scene.

<CLT=cltMIND>...I could ask Monokuma for a hint.
That would help, but...

I shouldn't waste my time trying to
solve an unsolvable problem.

<CLT=cltMIND>I still have some time left today.
Maybe I'll head out, clear my head...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to rest in bed?
Free Time will end if you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why did they go out of their way to make
this? What purpose could this serve?
